title: Further Roll-out of Mental Health Support Teams in Schools
what_it_is: Further Roll-out of Mental Health Support Teams in Schools

sections.label: School and community youth mental health
sections.summary: REACH provides mental health interventions in schools, while CREST-Youth, YITs and CHAT engage at-risk youths in the community.

sentences.speaker: The Senior Minister of State for Health (Dr Janil Puthucheary) (for the Minister for Health)
sentences.text: In schools, the Response, Early Intervention and Assessment in Community Mental Health (REACH) collaborates closely with the school and family to provide mental health interventions, such as depression, anger and anxiety management, coping skills and social skills group programmes to students with mental health needs.

sentences.speaker: The Senior Minister of State for Health (Dr Janil Puthucheary) (for the Minister for Health)
sentences.text: MOH will continue to work with the hospitals to ensure there are adequate resourcing for the REACH teams to cope with the needs from schools.

sentences.speaker: The Senior Minister of State for Health (Dr Janil Puthucheary) (for the Minister for Health)
sentences.text: In the community, we have set up services including the Youth Community Outreach Teams (CREST-Youth), Youth Integrated Teams (YITs) and Community Health Assessment Team (CHAT) that reach out and engage with at-risk youths.
